title: 90-Min Study With Me 🌧️ Rainy Window · Pomodoro 3 × 25/5 (No Music While Studying)
description:
Study with me for a focused session in a rainy window scene. 🌧️ A small timer sits quietly in the corner, and gentle motivational messages fade in now and then to keep you going. Music plays only in the breaks — while you focus there's just soft ambience.

⏱️ FORMAT
• 3 × 25/5 (focus / break)
• 10-second countdown to begin
• Minimal corner timer + soft on-screen motivation with a gentle chime
• 🎵 Music ONLY during breaks

🕖 TIMESTAMPS
00:00 — Intro & 10-second countdown
00:14 — Session 1 · Focus 25:00
25:14 — Break 05:00 (music)
30:14 — Session 2 · Focus 25:00
55:14 — Break 05:00 (music)
1:00:14 — Session 3 · Focus 25:00
1:25:14 — Break 05:00 (music)
1:30:14 — Well done 🎉

🎧 Best with headphones. Put your phone away and let's get things done.
🌱 Like & subscribe for daily study-with-me timers and deep-focus sessions.
